import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = process.cwd();
const require = createRequire(join(root, 'package.json'));
const { build } = createRequire(join(root, 'apps/billing-demo/package.json'))('esbuild');
const { chromium } = require('@playwright/test');
const ts = require('typescript');
const sha = (value) => createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');
const sourcePath = 'packages/core/src/acquisition-versions.ts';
const baselineSource = execFileSync('git', ['show', `HEAD:${sourcePath}`], { encoding: 'utf8' });
const candidateSource = readFileSync(join(root, sourcePath), 'utf8');
const compile = (source) => ts.transpileModule(source, {
  fileName: 'acquisition-versions.ts',
  compilerOptions: { target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022, module: ts.ModuleKind.ESNext, verbatimModuleSyntax: true },
}).outputText;
const withoutMap = (source) => source.replace(/\/\/# sourceMappingURL=.*$/m, '').trim();
assert.equal(withoutMap(compile(candidateSource)), withoutMap(readFileSync(join(root, 'packages/core/dist/acquisition-versions.js'), 'utf8')));
let overridden = 0;
const bundles = {};
for (const variant of ['baseline', 'candidate']) {
  const result = await build({
    stdin: {
      contents: "import * as readiness from './readiness-workload.mjs'; globalThis.tandroveReadiness = readiness;",
      resolveDir: join(root, 'apps/billing-demo/bench'),
      sourcefile: 'readiness-browser-entry.mjs',
    },
    bundle: true, platform: 'browser', format: 'iife', target: 'es2022', minify: true, write: false,
    define: { 'process.env.NODE_ENV': '"production"' },
    plugins: variant === 'baseline' ? [{
      name: 'previous-request-versions-only',
      setup(builder) {
        builder.onLoad({ filter: /acquisition-versions\.js$/ }, (args) => {
          assert.equal(args.path.replaceAll('\\', '/'), join(root, 'packages/core/dist/acquisition-versions.js').replaceAll('\\', '/'));
          overridden++;
          return { contents: compile(baselineSource), loader: 'js', resolveDir: dirname(args.path) };
        });
      },
    }] : [],
  });
  bundles[variant] = result.outputFiles[0].text;
}
assert.equal(overridden, 1);
const formal = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, '.artifacts/readiness/latest.json'), 'utf8'));
assert.equal(sha(bundles.candidate), formal.browserBundleSha256);
const report = {
  measuredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  method: 'Same-session attribution diagnostic, order baseline/candidate/candidate/baseline. Fresh browser context per run at 4x CPU throttle. Each runs unchanged planning then refresh workloads (100/1000 records, 1 warmup pair, 5 measured pairs). Only acquisition-versions.js is replaced in the baseline bundle with the transpiled HEAD source; all other runtime and harness code is identical. Not a replacement for the full formal rerun.',
  sourceCommit: execFileSync('git', ['rev-parse', 'HEAD'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim(),
  baselineSourceSha256: sha(baselineSource),
  candidateSourceSha256: sha(candidateSource),
  diagnosticScriptSha256: sha(readFileSync(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))),
  harnessSha256: formal.harnessSha256,
  bundleSha256: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(bundles).map(([key, value]) => [key, sha(value)])),
  environment: formal.environment,
  runs: [],
};
const browser = await chromium.launch({ headless: true });
assert.equal(browser.version(), formal.environment.chromium);
try {
  for (const variant of ['baseline', 'candidate', 'candidate', 'baseline']) {
    console.log(`Running ${variant} at 4x CPU throttle...`);
    const context = await browser.newContext();
    let timer;
    try {
      await context.route('**/*', (route) => route.abort());
      const page = await context.newPage();
      await page.goto('about:blank');
      await page.addScriptTag({ content: bundles[variant] });
      const cdp = await context.newCDPSession(page);
      await cdp.send('Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate', { rate: 4 });
      const refresh = await Promise.race([
        page.evaluate(async () => {
          globalThis.tandroveReadiness.runPlanningMeasurements();
          return globalThis.tandroveReadiness.runRefreshMeasurements({ recordCounts: [100, 1000], samples: 5 });
        }),
        new Promise((_, reject) => { timer = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Diagnostic profile exceeded five minutes')), 300000); }),
      ]);
      report.runs.push({ variant, refresh });
      console.log(JSON.stringify({ variant, medians: refresh.map((row) => ({ records: row.recordCount, full: row.full.wall.median, narrow: row.narrow.wall.median })) }));
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      await context.close();
    }
  }
} finally {
  await browser.close();
}
writeFileSync(new URL('./perf01-browser-ab.json', import.meta.url), JSON.stringify(report, null, 2) + '\n');
console.log('Same-session diagnostic complete.');
